description: This file defines a generator for Kubernetes API prerelease lifecycle annotations, including functions to extract version tags from type comments and generate lifecycle methods for API types.

classes.name: genPreleaseLifecycle
classes.description: A generator struct for creating prerelease lifecycle methods for API types.

methods.name: GetTargets
methods.description: Creates target definitions for code generation based on package comments and types.

methods.name: NewPrereleaseLifecycleGen
methods.description: Factory function to create a new generator for prerelease lifecycle code.

methods.name: Namers
methods.description: Returns name systems used for generating type names.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters types to determine if they should have lifecycle methods generated.

methods.name: versionMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the signature of a specific method, validating its parameters and results.

methods.name: versionedMethodOrDie
methods.description: Retrieves method signature or terminates on error.

methods.name: isAPIType
methods.description: Checks if a type has TypeMeta embedded, indicating it can serve as an API object.

methods.name: isOtherPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package is different from the target package.

methods.name: argsFromType
methods.description: Extracts versioning and replacement info from a type's comments for code generation.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initialization method for the generator, currently a no-op.

methods.name: GenerateType
methods.description: Generates lifecycle methods for a specific API type based on its tags.
